authorship: Independent source review; no authorship of this RMDag refactor and no compiler invocation.
ordinary_checks: Atomic instruction inversions are unchanged, including decPos/decZero exclusion and equal predecessor values.
All four non-normal car cases use the car induction hypothesis; normal-car competitors contradict its exit, while equal car exits align registers and determine the node exit.

The four non-restarting cdr cases first align intermediate registers using the normal-car induction hypothesis, then compare cdr exits/registers. A cdrCont1 competitor contradicts normal/brk/cont(k+2)/halt.

The restarting cdrCont1 case aligns both intermediate states before invoking the strictly smaller restarted-run induction hypothesis. Other car/cdr shapes are excluded by the corresponding exit equality.
Break and continue counters retain their original one-level consumption rules; no termination assumption or infinite-run claim is introduced.
first/rename_i select proof branches only; all branches are ordinary equality elimination, constructor disjointness and induction hypotheses.
